paite: Huan, Joseph tapa Manase suan Manase ta Makir, huai mi ta Gilea, huai mi ta Hepher tapa Zelophehad tanute a hong pai ua: a tanute min: Mala bang, Nova ban, Hogla bang, Milka bang, Tirza bang ahi uh.
english: Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

paite: Huan, kihoupihna puan inn kongkhak ah Mosi leh Siampu Eleazar leh mi liante leh omkhawmte tengteng maitam ah a va ding ua,
english: They stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

paite: Gamdai ah ka pu uh a si a, TOUPA sual ding a kikhawm pawl, Kora pawl ah tel tei kei: Himahleh amah khelh ziak in a si a, tapa a neikei hi.
english: “Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah: but he died in his own sin; and he had no sons.

paite: Tapa a neih louh ziak lel in bang ding a ka pa uh min a suante lak a kipan mang ding ahia? Ka pa unaute lak ah tantuan hon pia in, a chi ua.
english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

paite: Huan, Mosi in a thu uh TOUPA ma ah a tun a.
english: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Zelophehad tanute'n a hihdik uhi: a pa uh unaute lak ah tantuan na bawl ngei ding ahi, a pa uh tantuan na piak ding ahi.
english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: you shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers; and you shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

paite: Huan, Israel suante'n a kiang ah, Mi, tapa neilou a a sih leh a gou a tanute na piak ding uh ahi.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

paite: Huan, tanu a neih kei leh a gou a unaute na piak ding uh ahi.
english: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

paite: Huan, unaute a neih kei leh a gou a pa unaute na piak ding uh ahi.
english: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

paite: Huan, a pa'n unaute a neih kei leh a gou a tanau na pe ding ua, aman a luah ding a: huan, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in Israel suante ding in dan thupiak kip ahi ding, chi in gen in, chi in.
english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be to the children of Israel a statute and ordinance, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Abarim tang ah hohtou inla, Israel suante ka piak ding gam va en in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

paite: Huan, na muh khit chiang in na unaupa Aron a chipihte kiang ah pi a hih mah bang in nang leng pi na hi ta ding hi!
english: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

paite: Zin gamdai a a kikhawmte a phun lai ua a mitmuh ua tui a kei hon pahtawi ding a ka thu ka honpiak kalh a na hel ziak in, a chi a (Huaite Zin gamdai a Kadesa Mariba tuite ahi).
english: because you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

paite: Huan, Mosi in TOUPA a houpih a,
english: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,

paite: Khawmpite tung a om ding mi khat, sa tengteng khate Pathian, TOUPA'N sep hen.
english: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

paite: TOUPA mi khawmpite chingmi neilou belam bang a a om louhna ding un, a ma uh kai ding, amaute pikhia a pilut ding in, chi in.
english: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of Yahweh not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Nun tapa mi lungsim neitak Josua pi inla, a tungah na khut nga inla:
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him;

paite: Siampu Eleazar leh khawmpite ma ah ding sak inla, a mitmuh uah thuneihna pia in.
english: and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

paite: Huan, Israel suante omkhawm tengteng in thu a man theihna ding un a tungah na thupina nga in.
english: You shall put of your honor on him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

paite: Huchi in amah siampu Eleazar ma ah a ding diing a, aman TOUPA ma ah Urmin thu a laksak ding a: a thu in a pawt ding ua, a thu in a lut ding ua, amah leh Israel suante tengteng, omkhawmte toh a chi a.
english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

paite: Huan, Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in a hih a: Josua a pi a, Eleazar leh omkhawmte ma ah a ding sak a:Huan, a tungah a khut a nga a, Mosi zang a TOUPA'N a gen bang in thuneihna a peta hi.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

paite: Huan, a tungah a khut a nga a, Mosi zang a TOUPA'N a gen bang in thuneihna a peta hi.
english: and he laid his hands on him, and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.
